verdict.rationale: VLP Law Group is a law firm offering legal services such as fintech regulatory, venture financing, IP, and privacy counsel, not a software product, so official SDKs are a category error for this kind of offering. The evidence shows no software interface that would make the axis apply, and probes for llms.txt and OpenAPI specs all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
